An '''elixir''' was developed by the native [[Flesh Raider]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. This concocted elixir caused the Flesh Raiders to become much more aggressive and violent. Noted by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] pilgrim [[Vederiat Ayon]], she asked a Republic allied individual to put a stop to it.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=general|Strength of the Flesh Raiders |[[Tython/Legends|Tython]]}}</ref>
